snippet.title: Dragon Acres | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
On the Dragon Isles, the best farmhands breathe fire, call down rain, and zap pests before they reach your crops. They just have to trust you first.

Wishlist Dragon Acres on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1400030/Dragon_Acres/

Dragon Acres is a cozy farming RPG  about raising dragons and building a farm alongside them. Follow Eliot or Elie to the Dragon Isles to uncover the secret behind their grandmother’s legacy, settle a homestead and win your dragons over with good food, games, and a farm full of treasures worth guarding. The happier they are, the better your harvest!

When the fields are tended, there’s still plenty to do. Catch fish for the market or your dragons’ dinner, befriend villagers, complete quests, and ride the mine carts deep underground in search of new resources.
